requirements.historical_source_policy: Exchange-native OHLCV from two independent venues; closed bars only.
Exchange-published perpetual funding history; never backfill from current funding.
Native or licensed point-in-time OI history with timestamped provenance.
Exchange-published long/short positioning series; absent history disables the factor.
Point-in-time mark/index basis derived only from contemporaneous exchange records.
Checksum-verified exchange futures klines with published taker-buy volume, or aggregate trades converted to closed-bar taker flow.

Truthful live collection or licensed history; no fabricated historical liquidation events. Live evidence must bind durable connection sessions with at least 99.9% coverage and no gap over 120 seconds.

missing_feature_policy: A strategy that requires a missing historical feature is ineligible for that dataset; current values may never be copied backward.
